cases.name: clickable
cases.when: interactive is true and actionsEnabled is false or absent -- the chip root itself renders as <button>

cases.name: clickable-with-actions
cases.when: interactive is true and actionsEnabled is true -- a kebab cannot nest inside a button, so the root becomes a <div> and the interactive attributes move down to the chip BODY, a descendant <button>

cases.name: inert
cases.when: interactive is false or absent, regardless of actionsEnabled -- the consumer has declared the chip is not activated
cases.reason: A chip the consumer has declared non-interactive is a <div> with no role, no activation and nothing to disable. It is true whether or not actionsEnabled renders a kebab beside it -- the kebab is its own ArenaIconButton with its own accessible name and is not the subject of this binding -- so this whole pattern does not apply to the chip itself in this shape. `interactive` is a DECLARED member and never inferred from whether `click` is bound, which is what R6 asks and what the old inference got wrong.
